description: The entries of the near-life database kp-test-numbers.kdbx: an address book as a person keeps it, one number per entry, written in the formats people really use. Hand-kept. The stored text is the value of tel-values.json named by `value`; the links an entry must show are the expected links of the code cases with that value. All numbers are fictional. make_near_life.py builds near-life-spec.json and the database from this file.
